DriverProfile.title: DriverProfile
DriverProfile.description: Authenticated driver profile storing Horizon Festival progression, credits, selected car, and lifetime driving records.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the driver.

displayName.description: Driver callsign or Google display name (1-50 chars).

credits.description: In-game Horizon Credits (CR) earned from stunts and events.

selectedCarId.description: ID of the currently active car in the garage.

totalDriftScore.description: Cumulative drift score across all sessions.

boardsSmashed.description: Number of Horizon Bonus Boards smashed (0-50).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

OwnedCar.title: OwnedCar
OwnedCar.description: A car owned by the driver with custom festival paint and upgrade levels.

carId.description: Catalog car identifier matching document ID.

paintHex.description: Hex color code for body paint (#RRGGBB).

ZoneRecord.title: ZoneRecord
ZoneRecord.description: Personal best record for a Speed Trap, Drift Zone, or Horizon Circuit event.

zoneId.description: Event zone identifier matching document ID.

zoneType.description: Category of the Horizon event zone.

bestValue.description: Best speed (km/h), drift points, or fastest lap time (ms).

carId.description: Car ID used to set this personal best.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest personal best (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user driver profile and progression stats.

/users/{userId}/garage/{carId}.description: Cars owned and customized by the driver.

/users/{userId}/records/{zoneId}.description: Personal best event records for Speed Traps, Drift Zones, and Circuits.
